title: [bug] routing.rs:949 index underflow if a stored routing-table path is empty (path[path.len()-2])
description: DaoManager selected-candidate diagnostic (rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:949): path[path.len() - 2] panics with underflow if path.len() == 1's sibling branch is not taken... actually the guard is path.len()==1 -> node_address, else indexes path[len-2]; add_target_route admits empty paths (no min-length check on path), so a lookup returning an empty path slice would panic. Pre-existing edge case found by reviewer pass 3 of ow1e.111.7 (not introduced by the newtype change; the diff only touched that line incidentally). Fix: guard path.is_empty() or reject empty paths at add_target_route.
